name: QNB Corp.
summary: QNB Corp. operates as the bank holding company for QNB Bank that engages in the provision of commercial and retail banking products, and retail brokerage services in the United States. The company offers demand and savings accounts, such as money market accounts, interest-bearing demand accounts, club accounts, traditional statement savings accounts, and online savings account, as well as time deposits, including certificates of deposit and individual retirement accounts. It also provides commercial real estate loans comprising construction and land development loans; industrial loans; commercial and industrial loans; residential real estate loans; residential mortgage loans; consumer loans;…
